title: Kinetic energy at G
description: Essential: Final expression for kinetic energy at grid G must be correct: either E_k = ½mv₀² + (2φqh)/d or equivalent simplified form.

title: Horizontal displacement to G
description: Essential: Final expression for horizontal displacement l must be correct: l = v₀√(mdh/(qφ)).

title: Electric field identification
description: Important: Recognizes electric field magnitude between P and G (or Q and G) is E = 2φ/d, not φ/d.

title: Work-energy application
description: Important: Applies work-energy theorem correctly: work done by electric force = qEh = change in kinetic energy.

title: Vertical motion time
description: Important: Uses kinematics (h = ½at²) to find time to fall from initial height h to G, with a = qE/m.

title: Minimum plate length
description: Essential: Final expression for minimum plate length L must be correct: L = 2l = 2v₀√(mdh/(qφ)).

title: Symmetry reasoning
description: Important: Recognizes that trajectory from G to exit point below G is symmetric to first half, doubling horizontal displacement.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong sign for work (e.g., negative when positive) or misidentifies acceleration direction.

title: Field magnitude mistake
description: Pitfall: Uses E = φ/d (full separation) instead of E = 2φ/d (half separation to grounded mid-grid).

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Shows unit analysis confirming final expressions have correct dimensions (energy, length).
